meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Azure CLI(az quota)查询和管理你订阅里的 Azure 配额:列出指定区域与资源提供商的限额、当前用量和可用余量,对比多个区域的容量,并代你提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你要规划新部署、挑选 Azure 区域、排查「配额已超」报错或申请配额提升时触发;提到「检查配额」「服务限制」「当前用量」等词也会启用。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 配额,哪个余量更多
say.note: 逐区域列出限额与剩余容量

say.text: 把 standardDSv3Family 配额提到 500,并看申请状态
say.note: 提交提升请求并查询进度

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Azure CLI (az quota) to look up and manage Azure quotas in your subscription: list limits, current usage and available capacity per region/provider, compare regions, and submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you plan a deployment, choose an Azure region, troubleshoot 'quota exceeded' errors, or request a quota increase; also on 'check quotas', 'service limits' or 'current usage'.

say_en.text: Check quotas and available capacity for Microsoft.Compute in eastus
say_en.note: Returns a table of limit, usage and available

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quotas across eastus and westus2 to pick a region
say_en.note: Lists limits and remaining capacity per region

say_en.text: Raise standardDSv3Family quota to 500 and check request status
say_en.note: Submits the increase and shows its status
